focus.title: 美国拟对华半导体设备出口实施新限制，中企需提前评估供应链影响
focus.summary: 据多家国际媒体报道，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）正酝酿新一轮对华半导体设备出口管制措施，可能将部分成熟制程设备纳入管控清单，并扩大对第三方国家的限制。此举预计将影响中国半导体制造企业的设备采购与维护。建议相关企业立即梳理供应链，评估合规风险，并制定备选方案，同时关注最终规则文本及过渡期安排。
focus.source: 来源：综合路透社、彭博社报道 · 2026.08.11
focus.title_en: US Mulls New Export Curbs on Semiconductor Equipment to China; Firms Urged to Assess Supply Chain Impact
focus.summary_en: According to multiple international media reports, the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is considering a new round of export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China, potentially adding certain mature-node tools to the Entity List and expanding restrictions on third countries. This is expected to impact procurement and maintenance for Chinese chipmakers. Companies are advised to promptly review their supply chains, evaluate compliance risks, and develop contingency plans while monitoring the final rule and transition periods.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from Reuters, Bloomberg reports · 2026.08.11

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决获中国法院承认与执行：仲裁条款独立性原则再获确认
case.summary: 近期，中国某中级人民法院裁定承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）作出的一项仲裁裁决。该案中，被申请人主张主合同因欺诈无效，仲裁条款随之失效。法院援引《纽约公约》及中国仲裁法，强调仲裁条款独立性原则，认定主合同效力不影响仲裁条款效力，且仲裁程序符合正当程序要求，故予以承认。此案为跨境商事争议解决提供参考，凸显仲裁条款起草时明确独立性的重要性。
case.source: 来源：中国裁判文书网公开案例 · 2026.08
case.title_en: Chinese Court Recognizes and Enforces SIAC Award; Principle of Arbitration Clause Autonomy Reaffirmed
case.summary_en: In a recent ruling, an intermediate people's court in China recognized and enforced an arbitral award rendered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC). The respondent argued that the arbitration clause was invalid because the main contract was procured by fraud. The court, citing the New York Convention and Chinese arbitration law, emphasized the principle of separability of arbitration clauses, holding that the validity of the main contract does not affect the arbitration agreement, and that due process was observed. This case provides guidance for cross-border dispute resolution and underscores the importance of expressly providing for the autonomy of arbitration clauses.
case.source_en: Source: Public case from China Judgements Online · 2026.08

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境执业新规落地：港澳律师内地执业范围进一步扩大
policy.summary: 为深化粤港澳大湾区法治协同，国务院办公厅近日发布通知，进一步放宽港澳律师在大湾区内地九市执业限制，允许其从事更多类型的民商事法律事务，并简化执业申请流程。新规还明确将探索建立大湾区律师执业资格互认机制。此举将吸引更多港澳法律人才服务内地企业，助力大湾区企业“走出去”。相关企业可借此获得更便捷的跨境法律服务。
policy.source: 来源：国务院办公厅通知 · 2026.08
policy.title_en: New Rules Expand Practice Scope for Hong Kong and Macau Lawyers in the Greater Bay Area
policy.summary_en: To deepen legal collaboration in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), the General Office of the State Council has issued a notice further relaxing restrictions on Hong Kong and Macau lawyers practicing in nine mainland GBA cities, allowing them to handle a broader range of civil and commercial matters and simplifying application procedures. The notice also proposes exploring mutual recognition of legal qualifications within the GBA. This is expected to attract more legal talent to serve mainland enterprises and facilitate their global expansion. Companies may benefit from more accessible cross-border legal services.
policy.source_en: Source: Notice of the General Office of the State Council · 2026.08

analysis.title: 欧盟《外国补贴条例》实施一年：中企投标欧盟公共采购须提前布局补贴梳理
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》已实施一年，执法力度持续加强。近期多起针对中资企业的调查显示，欧委会对投标前补贴申报要求极为严格，未申报或申报不实可能导致高额罚款及排除出采购程序。建议中国出海企业建立内部补贴台账，对历年获得的各级政府补贴、优惠贷款等进行系统梳理，并在投标前完成合规评估。同时，关注欧委会对“扭曲性补贴”的认定标准，调整商业策略以降低风险。
analysis.source: 来源：欧盟委员会执法动态 · 2026.08
analysis.title_en: One Year of EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation: Chinese Firms Bidding in EU Public Tenders Should Prepare Subsidy Mapping
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation has been in force for one year, with enforcement intensifying. Recent investigations into Chinese enterprises show that the Commission requires rigorous pre-bid subsidy declarations; failure to declare or inaccurate declarations can lead to hefty fines and exclusion from procurement procedures. Chinese companies are advised to establish internal subsidy ledgers, systematically document subsidies, preferential loans, etc., from various government levels over the years, and conduct compliance assessments before bidding. Additionally, monitor the Commission's criteria for identifying 'distortive subsidies' and adjust business strategies to mitigate risks.
